description: This file defines functions and types for fetching and parsing HuggingFace models via an API, including caching mechanisms and model data processing.

methods.name: parseHuggingFaceModel
methods.description: Converts a HuggingFaceModel into a ModelInfo object, incorporating provider-specific details if available.

methods.name: getHuggingFaceModels
methods.description: Fetches available models from HuggingFace API, utilizing cache if valid.

methods.name: getCachedHuggingFaceModels
methods.description: Returns cached models without making an API request.

methods.name: getCachedRawHuggingFaceModels
methods.description: Returns cached raw models for UI display.

methods.name: getHuggingFaceModelsWithMetadata
methods.description: Fetches models with metadata, utilizing cache and API as needed.
